title: The Growing Seed
reflectionText: The man scatters the seed and then goes on with his life — sleeping, waking, sleeping again — while underground something he cannot see or explain is happening. The earth does the work by itself: blade, then head, then full grain. He does not make it grow; he only knows when it is time to reap. What is it to sleep and rise while the seed grows, though you do not know how?
